content: Gagashi' ki pe'ti ki Bitlus ɗǝ ge'lu Kǝndǝ Mbalǝn
Age' cini i Guu Hilidus gop mil bǝtl Yesu kal tǝngaki tǝ' hwotisi bǝnaɗa.
Il laki i tlo Yakubu yelse ki Yahaya nǝ bal pǝga.
Nǝ' en gu a mbuni Yahudawa u, i' gob Bitlus ɗaɗanu. Gu ndani ge' hwon ki dobga ki daddaɓǝl ki ulki ɗami u nǝbǝ yis nidɗawai u.
Kal ki gobtiti, illa'ti ge'lu kǝndǝ mbalǝn, ibbǝl sojoji upsi upsi lǝbi upsi sǝ' ɓutti, lyamti ki Hilidus tǝm mbilti kina ɗǝ mbalǝn, kal ki daddaɓǝl ki ɗakǝshti.
Iki is zǝ Bitlus a ge'lu kǝndǝ' mbalǝn, dobga ki mi' bǝtl Yesu kal is go' shilǝn nǝ Lya gawasi.
A ge' gasu nǝ ǝnlu a cilu nǝ Hilidus ti lyabti tǝ pekǝlti kina dǝ mbalǝn, Bitlus ati nde'emmbuɗi ge' dlom ki mi' kǝndǝ dlom lop, ki kǝndǝ nǝ zhimdom lop, ami' ɓutti dlabi atǝn bidlabi.
I mul shinkǝn ki Lya won mbǝ i lu kǝndǝ mbalǝn ni cili. Illi' Bitlus tǝn malgǝn itl tlilti lya, i' usu, “Dleuki, ɗǝ tlǝl lya!” Iki zhim domi waki Bitlus ɗǝ toh.
I mul shinkǝn ki Lya ni ultisu, “La' lu'lǝgǝl a shim kaptalanwagi.” I Bitlus pǝli nǝgu. “Dla' ul idlakiwagi a' bǝlǝnkal,”
I Bitlus bǝlti kal is pe' ɗǝge' lu kǝndǝ mbalǝni, amma tǝman ulnǝ mul shinkǝn ki Lya ɗǝ pǝlti u kǝnǝ baliwai; enti tiɗa kǝnǝ tlu'ti.

Is ɗakǝsh mi' ɓutti ki nǝm nǝ ki lop is mbǝ tǝn dlabi ki dom ki te' ge' gatli. I dlabini ɓulisi nigawasi, is petya giɓi. Nǝs gollǝtu is mbǝkǝci lu unǝ bal shitu i pa'ɗa u, a lǝbi a lǝbi i mul shinkǝn ki Lya ni za'ti.
Nǝ Bitlus pal ge' dliwasu i' usu, “Nǝguni amani i, bǝnǝ bwasti mbadlwai Lya kǝn shin mul shinkǝn was suɗi tǝppe'kǝlǝn te' toh ɗǝ Hilidus nǝ mus ulnǝ Yahudawa ɗǝ la'ti mbatl ki ndatwa su.”
Nǝgu ndanǝti u, illǝ libi ɗǝ Maliyamu dyaki Yahaya, gunǝ ɗǝ mbetti ki Malkus ɗaɗanu, lu u'nǝ mbalǝn domga ɗǝ shilǝn nǝ Lya ɗa u.
I Bitlus du dlalabi ki dla, i zheli won mul shin Loda lǝte' ɗǝ ya' woki mul du' dlabi ni.
Nǝm mani yal ki Bitlus kǝn u, ta ɓul dlabi niwai i' kum hwoltugi ippal tya nǝ kal nǝ kitǝl itl dlǝmi, “Bitlus tǝn dlabi.
Is ultisu “Ama ga niki ɗawa. Nǝ'go' dlǝmissi nǝgu ɗa u, is usu, mul shinkǝnki Lya was kǝni.”
Amma i Bitlus go' du' dlabi ni, nǝs ɓul dlabi ni u is enti, is kum gagashinti.
I Bitlus u nisi toh sǝddǝm shot itl dlǝmisi kan unǝ Lya pekkǝlti ɗǝge' lu kǝndǝ mbalǝn u. I' usu, “Dlǝmi Yakubu ne' yelsǝni mwani nǝ mudli tǝn ulu,” is za'si illǝ ge' kundu lu.
Nǝ lu cilu i bal dlatl nda ge dlom ki mi' kǝndǝ dlom tǝn ulnǝ nda nǝ Bitlus su.
Kal ki nǝ Hilidus ngauti ta mbitwai u, i' gop pǝtl mi' ɓuttiti i nǝ shilǝn il laki tǝ tlosi. Iki i Hilidus za' Yahudiya illǝ Kaisaliya iddǝm tyaka.
Mǝshti ki Hilidus

Hilidus ɗǝ leuwi mbatl tǝn mbalǝn ki Taya nǝ Sidon; is maga is mbǝmati nǝ mbatl nǝm, kal ki ngau ɗǝtl ma' Bilastasa, zheli ki guu is ngau dǝp ki zoki, gaki tǝn atl ki guu nisi ɗǝ ga'tisi si mbǝ' ulki ɗami ɗa.
A tǝn cin unǝ zǝdli, i Hilidus la'lu'lǝgǝl guntwasi, it dǝmtǝn lu dǝmti ki gunti ippǝli mbalǝn shilǝn.
Is la'yali, “Guki Yal ki lya, ki mbalǝnwai.”
Alǝbi alǝbi, gaki Hilidus a nal Lya wai, imul shinkǝn ki Lya li'ti atli, i zhǝɓǝl gob ɗapti in mǝtci.
Amma iki shilǝn ki Lya gop mbǝtl tǝnki a ɗǝ ɓulti.
Balnabas nǝ Shawulu
Balnabas nǝ Shawulu nǝs ngatl kautǝn wasǝn u, is palsu' Ulshelima, is mbǝ ne' Yahaya, gunǝ ɗǝ mbetti ki Malkus ɗaɗanu u.
